_comment: docs/152. Verifiers that FAIL on purpose when the rehearsal Config values reach them, because they pin the COMMITTED off state of a flag. tools/run_rehearsal.py treats a failure as expected only when its output matches `signature` AND every other failing line matches `only` (when given); anything else is reported as an INTERACTION. An entry whose verifier passes in the rehearsal is reported as stale. BD-626 (2026-10-18): the table is EMPTY on purpose. tools/run_rehearsal.py sets BD_REHEARSAL for every verifier it starts in the scratch tree, and each former pin now goes through tools/rehearsal_env.py (pin() puts that one flag into its off state in the verifier's own copy of the Config, so the off-state section still runs and the flag-on sections after it run too). Outside the rehearsal the pins are unchanged. Add an entry only for a verifier that cannot do that, with a reason.
